title: BeyondCorp Enterprise — Zero-Trust Access for Apps & Google Cloud
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Cloud / identity / Gemini enablement).

Google Cloud Console / gcloud / Cloud Identity / Google Admin authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version- or preview-dependent capabilities (SCC tiers, BeyondCorp features, org-policy constraints, VPC-SC behaviors, Gemini Enterprise features) cited or flagged 'verify in your organization', never invented. IaC (Terraform / Cloud Foundation Toolkit) at the pattern level. Automation is Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries) — no hardcoded credentials, no committed service-account keys, no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Replace VPN trust with identity- and context-aware zero-trust access
problem: Network location is not identity — a device inside the VPN isn't automatically trustworthy. This solution implements BeyondCorp Enterprise zero-trust access: Access Context Manager access levels (identity + device + context), Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) in front of web apps and VMs, context-aware access bindings, and device-trust signals — so access is granted per-request on who and what, not where, with no VPN.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the zero-trust model: Access Context Manager access levels, Identity-Aware Proxy, context-aware access, device signals, and how it relates to Workspace Context-Aware Access.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Organization, Cloud Identity, target apps/VMs, device signal source, admin roles).

Implementation Guide — define access levels, front a pilot app/VM with IAP, bind context-aware access, add device-trust signals, and validate deny/allow — then expand and retire VPN paths, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (access granted on identity+context, denied otherwise, VPN path retired) plus Best Practices for expanding zero-trust coverage.
short: Implement BeyondCorp Enterprise zero-trust access — Access Context Manager access levels, Identity-Aware Proxy for apps/VMs, context-aware bindings, and device-trust signals — so access is granted on who and what, not where, with no VPN. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
